Maya (CS): Heads up — Lumen Edge opted into the preview but we never completed enrollment. Need to lock schedule + prework so they actually try the flows.
Jon (CSM): I pinged their product lead earlier, said they're heads-down for a release this week. Might need an exec nudge.
Maya (CS): Risk: low engagement = higher churn risk at renewal. Proposal: 20-min recorded walkthrough + 30-min live workshop next Wednesday evening PST so their EU folks can join.
Priya (Solutions): Agree. Also want to add a small sandbox task (upload sample corpus + run one test gen) — that's the gating step.
Sam (PM): We can auto-provision a sandbox workspace but mark it "restricted" until they complete the task. Also plan a 2-week in-app feedback NPS targeted to the users who run the test.
DeployBot: Action required — enrollment form for Lumen Edge shows missing: billing contact, team size. Provisioning paused.
Jon (CSM): I'll chase billing contact now. If we don't hear back in 48h, I'll escalate to exec sponsor.
Maya (CS): Cool. Prework checklist ideas: 1) invite 3 engineers + 1 product, 2) upload sample data (csv/json), 3) run provided curl test, 4) watch 20-min walkthrough.
Priya (Solutions): I'll write the ingestion snippet and a minimal payload (JSON) + error troubleshooting points. Putting it in the shared drive.
Priya (Solutions): snippet:```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/infer \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"input":"hello world","mode":"beta-sample"}'
```
Sam (PM): Add a short survey after the walkthrough: 3 questions (ease, clarity, intent to use). We'll surface results to CS and Product.
Maya (CS): Ok action owners: Maya = send invite + prep agenda, Jon = billing + sponsor nudge, Priya = sandbox + curl doc, Sam = set up NPS and dashboard.
Jon (CSM): Update — billing contact replied. They want 15 seats but only 4 engineers listed. Recommend provisioning 8 seats to start.
Maya (CS): Provision 8. Note on handoff: if adoption <40% at day 14, trigger renewal flag and schedule a targeted enablement.
DeployBot: Enrollment updated — billing contact completed, provisioning task opened for 8 seats.
Priya (Solutions): I'll also include a short FAQ for rate limits and common errors to reduce early support burden.
Maya (CS): Please drop any customer-specific notes in this thread. I'll follow up on adoption metrics day 7 and 14. Thanks team :raised_hands:
